design: Prospective follow-up triggered by repeated inspections in the first observed block of the fragment experiment. Same seeded defects, cases and limits as initial, new independent sessions. F=TIDE neutral fragment workflow from the first experiment, D=TIDE source/test provenance instruction built into fragment_view, P=CPython equivalent provenance instruction and same fragment schema. Three blocks per task, reverse Latin squares, serial, each condition in every position once per family. Freeze before first follow-up. Primary paired differences in time to successful verification and gross input+output tokens D-F and D-P. Report command counts and failures. Prior blocks excluded from these differences.
evidence: The directory listing, reachable source inspection and ./verify have already run on this same snapshot. Use the supplied results for your first proposal. Inspect only if a specific fact needed to propose a repair is missing.
